E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, reported that the city provided
transportation to parents from Hawaiian Elementary for a tour of Cerritos College; working with
elementary schools to have a comradery fun day for 6th grade students; spotlighted the youth sports
program; announced that the scholarship dinner will be held on Saturday, May 11th.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director announced that a Neighborhood Safety Meeting will be held on
Wednesday, May 1st at Coco’s Bionicos.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that a tire recycling program will be held on
Saturday, Nay 18; and provided an update on the construction on Norwalk Blvd.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Vargas requested staff to explore the possibility of a community festival for the
upcoming street fair, to showcase the community’s historical representation.

Councilmember Roa had opportunity to be out with youth sports staff, express some concern with the
sign up process for the volunteer program.

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula reported on Education Committee; announced that SELACO is providing
resources to those impacted by 99cent store closures; and requested that the city host a shredding
event.

Mayor Farfan reported that on April 12th he attended a regional training opportunity seminar, a
collaboration between local community colleges and SELACO; on April 19th he attended ABC Job Fair;
and attended an Elementary School Track Meet.
